# datalog-engine

> In-memory stratified Datalog engine in pure Python with semi-naive evaluation, DRed incremental view updates, aggregates, and derivation explanations. Python package `trysac-datalog-engine`, import name `datalog_engine`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
